name: we-build-for-good-invariants
description: Canonical manifest of studio invariants and code standards.

rules.description: Code must strictly match Prettier formatting standard.
Strict prohibition of em dashes in all code, commits, and public copy. Use colons, commas, or parentheses.
Single source code files should not exceed 400 lines to prevent monolithic unmaintainable code.
Public copy and links must use sovereign studio domains and exclude obsolete staging handles.
